spec.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
spec.summary: Decide whether a nonempty binary tree satisfies the binary search tree rule at every node: all values anywhere in its left subtree are strictly smaller, all values anywhere in its right subtree are strictly larger, and both subtrees obey the same rule.
spec.description: Decide whether a nonempty binary tree satisfies the binary search tree rule at every node: all values anywhere in its left subtree are strictly smaller, all values anywhere in its right subtree are strictly larger, and both subtrees obey the same rule. Equal values are invalid.

approaches.name: Carry Allowed Bounds
approaches.summary: Pass each node an exclusive lower and upper bound inherited from its ancestors.
thinkingSteps: Begin with no lower or upper bound.
Reject a node outside its inherited open interval.
Narrow the interval for left and right children.

bullets: The rule applies to all descendants, not only direct children.
Values equal to a bound are invalid.
An ancestor can rule out a distant node.
